result: Narrowed; original status retained. For the additive group Z2 with trivial Z2 coefficient action, the Boolean 3-cochain omega(a,b,c)=a*b*c is normalized and satisfies the cocycle identity. Every normalized 2-cochain beta has coboundary zero at (1,1,1), whereas omega is one there. Thus omega is not a normalized coboundary, and normalized 2-cochain rephasing leaves a negative sign at that triple.
proof_boundary: The result concerns the explicitly defined Z2 cochain model and normalized rephasings. It constructs no BF state sum, 2-group gauge dynamics, knotted-worldsheet amplitude or three-loop braiding observable. No general cancellation or sign-free theorem follows.
